mechanics: read the kind halfword at +0x12 as a zero extended 16 bit value
treat kind 0x0001 and kind 0x0010 as modelled and every other kind as unmodelled
return the literal sentinel address 0x015d115d for any unmodelled kind
for a modelled kind read the flags halfword at +0x10 and mask it with 0x0030
when the masked storage bits are nonzero return the pointer stored at +0x00
when the masked storage bits are zero and the kind is nonzero return the receiver address itself
when the masked storage bits are zero and the kind is zero return null
no receiver field is ever written
